domain-information: An Architect develops conceptual designs and sketches to capture the client’s vision for a building
An Architect reviews design drafts and incorporates feedback to refine the project plans
A Project Manager coordinates project timelines and ensures deadlines are met for design submissions
A Project Manager communicates with contractors and city officials to secure necessary permits
A Draftsperson translates conceptual sketches into technical drawings and detailed floor plans
A Draftsperson updates drawings to reflect changes requested by the architect or client
A Client Relations Specialist gathers requirements from clients and documents their preferences
A Client Relations Specialist forwards the documents to the architect
A Client reviews proposed designs and provides feedback on style, functionality, and budget considerations
A Client approves final plans and confirms design choices before construction begins

domain objects.name: Architect
domain objects.description: Professional who creates conceptual designs and refines building plans

domain objects.name: Conceptual Design
domain objects.description: Early design representation capturing the vision for a building

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Input provided to improve or adjust a design

domain objects.name: Project Manager
domain objects.description: Person responsible for coordinating timelines and project activities

domain objects.name: Project Timeline
domain objects.description: Schedule outlining key design and submission deadlines

domain objects.name: Permit
domain objects.description: Authorization required from authorities for project approval

domain objects.name: Draftsperson
domain objects.description: Specialist who produces technical drawings and floor plans

domain objects.name: Technical Draft
domain objects.description: Detailed technical drawing derived from conceptual designs

domain objects.name: Review
domain objects.description: Evaluation process of design drafts for quality and accuracy

domain objects.name: Client Relations Specialist
domain objects.description: Role responsible for gathering requirements and communicating with clients

domain objects.name: Requirement Documentation
domain objects.description: Collection of a client’s needs and preferences for the project

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Person who provides requirements and approves final project designs

associations.description: Architect performs the Review of design drafts
Feedback informs the Architect about needed design adjustments
Draftsperson uses the Conceptual Design as a basis for technical work
Review guides the Draftsperson in updating drawings
Client Relations Specialist creates the Requirement Documentation
Requirement Documentation informs the Architect about client needs
Client Relations Specialist collects requirements from the Client
Project Manager maintains the Project Timeline
Project Timeline constrains when the Conceptual Design must be completed
Project Timeline sets deadlines for the Technical Draft
Client provides Feedback on proposed designs
Client participates in the Review of design proposals
Feedback influences changes to the Conceptual Design
Review determines updates needed in the Technical Draft
